propositions: _hash_basis catches broad Exception during gate-ref resolution and silently returns the working tree as hashing basis instead of failing closed
When the gate ref cannot be resolved but the working tree matches signed content, compute_validity certifies the attestation instead of blocking with stale-code
The claim gate's drift check is invisible to its verdict consumer when the hashing basis degrades, violating the documented fail-closed posture and ADR 0002
The review-bot's clone and deployed MCP box systematically lack origin/main resolution capability, causing the fallback to fire on 100% of runs with no trace other than a WARNING log line
A configured attested gate must block when it cannot obtain the gate ref but currently permits attestation by comparing against a substituted working tree
The substitution must be surfaced as a degradation signal so the claim gate can refuse certification and name the unobtainable ref in its reason
